errors.evidence: The figure's title states the contracts are "финансирани от държавния бюджет" (financed by the state budget). The description incorrectly adds the phrase "финансирани по оперативни програми" (financed by operational programs), which is not mentioned anywhere in the visual information of the chart itself.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е вертикалната ось, означена с „Стойност, млн. лв.“ с линейна скала.
errors.evidence: The figure does not have a labeled vertical (Y) axis with a scale. The label 'Стойност, млн. лв.' is part of the legend and identifies the orange line series, it does not label an axis.

errors.text_span: Диапазонът на стойностите е от 1846 до 667, с интервали от 200 милиона лева.
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a visible Y-axis scale, range, or intervals. The stated range and intervals are completely fabricated. The number 1846 is a data point for the 'Брой' series, not part of a range, and 667 appears to be a misreading of the data point 5667.2.

errors.text_span: Първа линия, обозначена с прекъсната червена линия, представляваща „Брой“
errors.evidence: The line representing 'Брой' (Number) is blue, not red.
The value for the 'Брой' (Number) line in 2017 is 2170. The value 1694.2 (misread as 694.2) belongs to the 'Стойност' (Value) line for the year 2018.

errors.text_span: достига връх при стойност 2313 през 2015 г.
errors.evidence: For the 'Брой' series, the value in 2015 is 2335, and this is not a peak. The value for 2014 is 2313.

errors.text_span: Втората линия, обозначена с плътна червена линия, представляваща „Стойност“
errors.evidence: The line representing 'Стойност' (Value) is orange, not red.
The value for the 'Стойност' (Value) line in 2022 is 2576.2. The value 3522 belongs to the other line, 'Брой' (Number), for the same year.

errors.text_span: Линията се покачва от 2 335 през 2014 г. до 667 през 2019 г.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly describes the 'Стойност' (Value) line. The value in 2014 is 1233.8, not 2335 (which belongs to the other line). The value in 2019 is 5667.2, not 667.

errors.text_span: Линията нараства от 2 871 през 2016 г. до 6 899 през 2020 г.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly describes the 'Стойност' (Value) line. The value in 2016 is 2028.9 (the value 2871 belongs to the other line). The value in 2020 is 1820.0 (the value 1689.9, possibly misread as 6899, is from 2021).
